audience: developers who send webhooks to their own customers with Svix

useCases.title: Find out why a webhook did not arrive
useCases.text: The AI lists the recent messages of a customer application and every delivery attempt for one message, with status, response code and response body.

useCases.title: Check if a customer endpoint is healthy
useCases.text: The AI reads an endpoint's counts of success, pending, sending and fail, and lists its delivery attempts filtered by status to find the failures.

useCases.title: See which event types customers can subscribe to
useCases.text: The AI lists the event types and reads one with its description and JSON schema. You can also see which types an endpoint is subscribed to.

useCases.title: Resend a message or replay failed ones
useCases.text: The AI queues one message for redelivery to one endpoint, or replays all failed messages of an endpoint since a time. It then follows the background task.

useCases.title: Add a customer application and a webhook endpoint
useCases.text: The AI creates an application for a new customer and registers an endpoint URL for it, optionally limited to chosen event types and channels.

useCases.title: Send a webhook message to a customer
useCases.text: The AI sends a message with an event type to every endpoint of an application that subscribes to it. This delivers real traffic to your customers' URLs.
